Name: Fruit Rugs
Author: gravitance
Description:
This mod is a mini experimental project. Literally just replaces the patchwork rug with one that has a strawberry on it. [ Looks Away. ]

Requires the following mods already installed:
1. Content Patcher
2. SMAPI

Instructions:
1. Download the file
2. Unzip into Mods folder
3. Launch the game normally with SMAPI
